name: Danse Macabre
source:
Countess Nadia is planning another Masquerade at Vesuvia's palace – but this one will be much more than a fancy ball.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
娜迪婭女伯爵正籌劃在維蘇維亞宮殿再辦一次假面舞會——不過這一次，遠不只是一場華麗的舞會。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
